messages:
Kai W.: Hey folks — first week! Running into an odd one: the Grafana dash embedded in the onboarding playbook shows "panel not found" but opening the dash directly works. Embed URL: https://grafana.redwood.example/d-solo/emb123/service-ops?orgId=1&panelId=2
Jordan (devex): welcome Kai! :tada: Are you viewing the playbook in Confluence or the docs site? Also, do you see a long sig=... query param?
Kai W.: Confluence. I see sig param. Console shows 401 on /render/d-solo. I'm on SSO but not on corp VPN atm.
Marta (obs-eng): we rotated embed tokens earlier this month — Confluence pages need updated signed URLs. If you're remote, VPN is required for some embeds. I'll generate a fresh signed URL. @DevEx Bot can you open a ticket and add Kai?
DevEx Bot: Created ticket #DX-3724 - "playbook embeds: regen signed grafana embeds for onboarding; add kai.w@redwood.ai". Assignee: Jordan. ETA: 6 hours.
Kai W.: thanks. Also two related onboarding items while we're here: 1) datadog CLI gives Forbidden when I try `datadog app-key create --name kai-cli`; 2) Sentry only shows my personal org not the company projects. Who owns those perms?
Jordan (devex): Datadog app keys require an app key tied to a user and app-key creation can be restricted. We'll add app-key creation to #DX-3724. For Sentry, obs-eng handles org team membership.
Marta (obs-eng): Kai, send the repo names or Sentry project slugs you need and I'll add you to the appropriate teams. For Datadog, if CLI create is forbidden we can request infra to either create the app key or grant you observability-cli role.
Kai W.: repos: github.com/redwood/kiosk and github.com/redwood/telemetry-proxy. Sentry slugs kiosk and telemetry-proxy. Also, small question: how do I favorite dashboards so they appear on Grafana Home? I tried favoriting but it doesn't stick.
Marta (obs-eng): favoriting requires folder-level view permission. If you can't favorite, you're probably missing the `redwood-observability-viewers` group. Jordan, can you check group membership and add it to the ticket?
Jordan (devex): done — added a subtask to #DX-3724: "Add kai.w@redwood.ai to redwood-observability-viewers". Also added Datadog app-key and Sentry project requests.
Kai W.: VPN + cleared cache — embed still 401 but ticket noted. Appreciate the quick triage. Will follow #DX-3724. 
Marta (obs-eng): follow-up: I generated a fresh signed embed and updated the playbook link. Try the original iframe after a hard refresh.
Kai W.: tried — embed now loads and favoriting works. Sentry shows the two projects too. Thanks all! :heart: 
Jordan (devex): welcome aboard! Closing this thread; updates will remain in #DX-3724.
